items.headline: Gary power outage spoils food and drives emergency meal need
items.summary: AP reported that a prolonged Gary power outage spoiled food and forced families to seek hot meals and emergency food support.
items.uncertainty_note: The source does not quantify the full household count affected.
items.why_it_matters: A prolonged power outage created food spoilage and emergency meal pressure for Gary households.
